name: Weekly GitHub Dev Summary (Claude)
description: Weekly GitHub activity summary (commits, closed issues, merged PRs via GitHub search API) via Claude Sonnet 4 narrative with Discord, Slack, or email delivery. Load Config validates GITHUB_REPO format (GitHub-safe characters only) and emits weekStart/weekEnd ISO8601 bounds for the rolling 7-day window. Build Claude Prompt filters activity by weekStart, excludes pull_request entries from closed-issues counts (GitHub /issues returns both), and assembles claudeRequest with localized EN/FR system prompts. Claude API tolerates transient Anthropic failures; Format Summary shapes discordBody, slackBody, markdown, and email payloads (Discord 1800 / Slack 2800 char limits; emailSubject, emailText, emailHtml with HTML-escaped summary) from the Claude narrative or falls back to weekly activity stats before Route Delivery. Load Config validates SUMMARY_EMAIL_TO and SUMMARY_EMAIL_FROM as valid email addresses when email delivery is selected (SUMMARY_EMAIL_FROM defaults to n8n@localhost when unset); DELIVERY_CHANNEL selects the destination or auto-detects from webhook/email $env vars; Route Delivery switch routes to the matching channel; Send Email resolves fromEmail from Load Config emailFrom and toEmail from Load Config emailTo. Collects activity from three parallel paginated GitHub API fetches; Merge GitHub Results uses append mode to sync parallel branches with fail-fast validation. Validates GITHUB_TOKEN via GET /repos/{owner}/{repo} before API calls. Runs Fridays at 5pm (America/New_York). Supports EN/FR localization. Secrets load from n8n $env at runtime — use n8n Credentials, HashiCorp Vault, or your host secrets manager in production; never hardcode API keys in workflow JSON.
